name: Automated Testing and CI/CD
summary: Ship often without fear: automate the checking and the releasing.
prerequisites: Requires a repository of your own and something in it to test. No particular language: the pipeline is the same for all of them.
syllabus: Test doubles, fixtures and test data
Coverage: what it tells you and what it does not
Continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines

topics.title: Unit, integration, functional and acceptance tests
Test doubles: stub, mock, spy and fake
Fixtures, factories and test data sets
Code coverage: what it measures and what it does not
Continuous integration: triggers, jobs and matrix runs
GitHub Actions and GitLab CI in practice
Continuous delivery and continuous deployment: the difference
Secrets in the pipeline and least privilege
Release strategies: blue-green, canary and feature flags
